name: Vue.js
body: Every page analyzed has a meta description and every image alt text, HSTS is on, and an llms.txt lists 94 links. But no page analyzed carries JSON-LD, so search and AI answers get no entity naming the project.
lesson: Add WebSite and Organization blocks with sameAs links to GitHub and social profiles.
summary: vuejs.org scores 87 out of 100 (B). 0 checks fail now, 21 are at risk, and 17 pass. Fix first: 20 pages have no canonical link.

fix.title: 20 pages have no canonical link
fix.evidence: /, /guide/quick-start, /guide/introduction, /tutorial/ and 16 more. Without it, tracking parameters and trailing slashes can split ranking signals.
fix.fix: Add <link rel="canonical" href="…"> with the page's own https URL.

fix.title: X-Content-Type-Options is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers may guess a file's type and run it as script. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

fix.title: Referrer-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers fall back to their default. An explicit policy keeps full URLs from leaking to other sites. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

fix.title: 12 indexable pages are missing from the sitemap
fix.fix: Add them to the sitemap or regenerate it on each deploy.

fix.title: No Organization or Person entity describes who is behind the site
fix.evidence: AI answers lean on this to name the brand, its logo, and its profiles. The page links 12 profiles that could go in sameAs.
fix.fix: Add Organization (or Person) JSON-LD with name, url, logo, and sameAs. The fix kit has a draft.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 525 ms
Every page has a meta description
